description.value: Sandown Liquor Store is the first Springs Group location on Vancouver Island, situated in the Sandown Shopping Centre just off the second exit from the Swartz Bay ferry terminal — a convenient stop for cyclists arriving by ferry. The store features a spacious floorplan and a massive walk-in cooler stocked with local island craft beers, ciders, wines, seltzers, and spirits. Free ice is offered with any purchase, and a VIP Points loyalty program is available.

address.value: 10330 McDonald Park Rd. Suite #108, North Saanich, BC V8L 5X7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully confirms this is an active Springs Group liquor store at 10330 McDonald Park Rd., Suite #108, North Saanich, BC, with phone 778-357-3392 — providing the address and phone absent from OSM tags. The site describes a spacious retail store in Sandown Shopping Centre with a large walk-in cooler and local craft beer selection, and explicitly offers curbside/online ordering. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike racks, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the verified address places the store in North Saanich; the website itself notes it is 'just across from Sidney', so the OSM community assignment is geographically loose but not egregiously wrong.
OSM record carries no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed fields are null rather than true.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible retail liquor store conveniently located near the Swartz Bay ferry terminal — a useful stop for touring cyclists arriving or departing by ferry.
